scientific_integrity: Analytical global proof with symbolic and time-domain checks; numerical verification is corroborative, not a proof of a continuum result. The accessible literature comparison is not a guarantee of publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Only a unit-mass isotropic critically damped harmonic trap with fixed active-force amplitude, thermal bath temperature and fixed chiral angular drift is classified. The heat objective is translational bath heat, not the complete energetic cost of driving angular chirality. No independent scientific audit or experimental validation has occurred.
title: Reentrant optimization of dissipation in a critically damped chiral active oscillator
